ObjectName.value: Gravestone Anna St Thomas Mount Chennai Aug22 R16 06221

Categories.value: St. Thomas Church on the Mount|Self-published work|Latin inscriptions in India|Gravestones in India|Media with estimated locations|Armenian inscriptions|Files with coordinates missing SDC location of creation|Images by User:Tagooty|Images by User:Tagooty/India

ImageDescription.value:
Gravestone in the entrance of the Shrine of Our Lady of Expectation, with Armenian and Latin inscriptions. St. Thomas Mount, Chennai, India.

Translation of the Latin inscription, by Priscilla T. Gonsalves:

"Here beneath this monument lies Anna Jacobyan who was the beloved wife of Sultan David and dearest to her Nation of Light, Armenia, especially to her own blood relatives originating from the city of Julpha in Persia and aged sixty four years old, died in Madras on the 20th February 1764."
